name: Look Twice
source:
In Look Twice you find yourself in a strange world, piecing together what you can about your situation and the unknown girl who is with you.

[from the [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]official site[/url]]
translation:
在《Look Twice》中，你会发现自己身处一个奇怪的世界，只能一点点拼凑出自己的处境，以及与你同在的那个神秘女孩的情况。

[来自 [url=http://atpprojects.mygamesonline.org/visualnovels.htm]官方网站[/url]]
